newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Amtek in S$20 million joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Amtek in S$20 million joint venture.

text.p: Amtek Engineering Ltd said on Tuesday it has signed a tri-partite joint venture agreement to incorporate a company with an authorised capital of Singapore $20 million.

The new venture, ASE Investments Pte Ltd (ASE), has the objective of making strategic investments in end-product manufacturing projects in telecommunication products, medical divices and energy-related products, Amtek said in a statement. The partners in the venture are Sanwa Plastic Industries Pte and EDB Investments Pte Ltd, an investment arm of Singapore's Economic Development Board. Sanwa is a plastic injection moulder and a partner of Amtek in other joint ventures.

ASE's authorised capital is divided into 16 million ordinary shares and 4 million redeemable convertible preference shares (RCPS), all of S$1.00 each. Amtek and Sanwa will each subscribe for 8 million ordinary shares, while EDBI will subscribe for the RCPS, Amtek said.
